text: なかなか　アングルも　きまらない　まま　すすまないわ…

structure.jp: なかなか　アングルも　きまらない　まま
structure.en: with the angle still just not settled

patterns.name: 〜まま
patterns.explanation: まま means things stay as they are, with nothing changing. きまらない　まま = 'still not decided'.

patterns.name: なかなか〜ない
patterns.span: なかなか　アングルも　きまらない
patterns.explanation: なかなか with a 'not' verb means something just won't happen, however long you try. なかなか　きまらない = 'it just won't get decided'.
